Article Title: Winter is coming: From capacity to safety, the things you cannot miss in your next Geyser
Article Text:
Disclaimer: It is an AI-generated image

Start with the right capacity

Storage or instant?

Check the energy rating

Tank material and hard water

Pressure rating matters

Installation is part of safety

Smart features and after-sales service

Before you buy

As temperatures begin to dip across the country, the geyser moves from an afterthought to a daily essential. Few things feel worse than stepping into a cold bathroom on a frosty morning only to find the water barely lukewarm, and few household appliances are as easily taken for granted until they fail. Whether you are replacing an ageing unit that has served you for a decade or buying your first, the choices you make now will shape your winter in more ways than one. The correct and right geyser means constant hot water, lower electricity bill and complete peace of mind. On the other hand, a hasty and uninformed purchase would mean weeks of cold showers, repeated repairs and in worse cases can also lead to some accident. So, from capacity and energy rating to tank material and safety features, here is what to weigh before you buy, so your geyser keeps you warm without nasty surprises.The first thing to check while buying a geyser is the capacity. Always keep in mind that bigger is not always better. A larger tank takes a lot of time to heat and it also uses more amount of electricity. So, it’s important that you decide of the capacity of the geyser with the size of your family.* 1 to 3 people: A 15-litre geyser is usually enough.* 4 to 5 people: Look at 25 litres.* Larger households or multiple bathrooms: Go for 35 litres or more, or consider more than one unit.* Kitchen or washbasin use: A 3 to 6-litre instant geyser heats water in seconds and suits small, quick needs.If your family showers at the same time every morning, size up. If usage is spread through the day, a smaller tank works.Another important parameter to keep in mind while purchasing a geyser is whether to go for storage or instant model. The Storage geyser heats the water in a tank and keeps it hot. This functionality of storage geyser makes it a better option for bathrooms and several users. On the other hand, instant geysers heat water as it flows, so there is no waiting and no standby loss, but the flow will also be limited. On the other hand, gas geysers are also an option where piped gas is available, however, they need an excellent source of ventilation, as poor airflow can cause buildup of carbon monoxide. It is advisable to never install gas geyser in closed bathrooms.It is always important to check the energy star rating before buying any electrical appliance. Buyers should keep in mind that a geyser may run for hours everyday during the winter season, so the efficiency matters a lot. Always look for Bureau of Energy Efficiency (BEE) star rating. Remember that a 5-star unit uses less standby energy as compared to a poorly rated one. The device with 5-star rating will come with a heftier price tag but it will eventually help you a lot in saving your electricity cost later. Good insulation, usually polyurethane foam around the tank, keeps water hot for longer and reduces how often the heater switches on.The inner tank decides how long the geyser lasts. Stainless steel tanks resist corrosion well, while glass-lined or coated tanks offer a cheaper alternative. If your area has hard water, as many parts of north India do, scale will build up on the heating element and shorten its life. Look for a geyser with a corrosion-resistant tank and a magnesium anode, and plan to descale it once a year.Not all geysers can handle all plumbing. If you live in a high-rise or use a pressure pump, check the working pressure the geyser is built for. Buying a unit rated for lower pressure than your supply can cause leaks or even tank damage.Safety features you should not skipThis is where it pays not to cut corners.* ISI mark: Always ensure that the geyser carries an ISI mark rating which clearly states that the device meets Indian safety standards.* Thermostat and thermal cut-out: These markers stop the geyser when water reaches the set temperature, and then cut off power if it overheats.* Pressure relief or safety valve: The safety valve reduced the excess pressure and decreases the risk of tank bursting.* Water-protection rating: Always look for IPX4 or higher rating as it protects the geyser from splashes in damp bathrooms.* Earthing and ELCB: Always use a three-pin plug with proper earthing, and consider an ELCB or RCCB on the circuit to guard against electric shock.Geysers draw a lot of current, so use a dedicated switch and wiring rated for the load. Avoid plugging them into a loose or overloaded socket.A filled 25-litre geyser can weigh well over 30 kg. It should be fixed to a strong wall with the brackets supplied, not mounted on a weak partition. Install it out of direct splash, ideally outside the shower area, and use only an authorised technician. Make sure the inlet and outlet pipes are fitted correctly and that the safety valve is not blocked.Nowadays, a lot of models are available in the market which comes with various smart features. For instance, the geysers now come with timers, digital temperature displays and app control which can help reduce the use of power and also prevent the appliance from staying on the entire day. These features are use but they should not come at a cost of other important safety features. Also, always check for the warranty, which usually covers the tank fr longer than the heating element. Also, make sure that you go for a brand which has a proper service network in your city.Before buying your new geyser it is important that you compare the capacity, star rating, tank material, safety features and warranty rather than only the price. A well and thoughtfully selected geyser would last for years and also a care purchase made now will payoff in the upcoming and every other winter morning.
Article Summary: The correct and right geyser means constant hot water, lower electricity bill and complete peace of mind. From capacity and energy rating to tank material and safety features, here is what to weigh before you buy. Buyers should keep in mind that a geysers may run for hours everyday during the winter season, so the efficiency matters.

Article Title: Fake Google Chrome app with over 1 lakh downloads found on Google Play: How to spot and what to do next
Article Text:
Google Play

Fake Google Chrome app hiding in plain sight as an ad

From a casual game to a fake browser

How to spot fake apps and avoid scams

Check the publisher directly underneath the app title to ensure it matches the official creator or parent company.

Paid ad placements only mean someone paid for visibility; they do not guarantee legitimacy.

High install tallies do not automatically confirm safety, especially if an older app has been repurposed.

Be alert to installed apps that unexpectedly change their identity, icon, or functionality.

What to do if you installed the app

A fake version of the Google Chrome browser appeared on the official Google Play Store , displaying over 1 lakh (100,000) downloads and securing a paid “sponsored” placement directly above Google’s genuine browser. The deceptive listing copied Chrome’s official branding, app icon, promotional screenshots and store description, but listed an entirely unrelated entity as its creator. Following widespread user complaints online, Google moved quickly to take down the fake listing.The issue came to light on October 14 after a Reddit user posted a screenshot showing two nearly identical Chrome apps appearing side-by-side in Google Play search results. The top result – promoted via a paid sponsored slot – featured the official Chrome name and logo, but displayed Hizbartech as the publisher. The legitimate Google Chrome app, published by Google LLC, appeared underneath the imposter ad.The fake listing copied the look and feel of the authentic browser, as well as the store copy, so everyday users looking for the browser could easily be fooled.Reported investigations show that the fake app did not start life as a browser clone.The app first appeared on the Play Store in August 2026 as a mobile game named Ball Bounce. But in late September 2026, the developer altered the existing listing, changing the title, graphics and descriptions to impersonate Google Chrome. The application kept the original base Android package name of com.ballbounce.Hizbartech.This repurposing explains the high download metric: the 1 lakh (100,000) installs reflected historical downloads accumulated while the app operated as a casual game, rather than 100,000 users intentionally installing a cloned browser.Users who downloaded the app reported that it did not function as a web browser at all. Instead, it opened into an unrelated chat utility featuring digital avatars and automated replies.The clearest indicator that the app was a fake was the developer profile. Google’s official browser is published by Google LLC, not third-party accounts like Hizbartech. “Key verification checks” are the key to prevent malicious downloads on Android:Android users who mistakenly download the counterfeit Chrome app – or anyone who still has the original Ball Bounce app by Hizbartech installed – should delete the application from your device immediately. Run Google Play Protect. Open the Google Play Store, navigate to Play Protect, and run an immediate device scan to detect any lingering malicious files.
Article Summary: A fake version of the Google Chrome browser appeared on the official Google Play Store. The deceptive listing copied Chrome’s official branding, app icon, promotional screenshots and store description. The fake listing copied the look and feel of the authentic browser, as well as the store copy.

Article Title: Edmonton Oilers captain Connor McDavid renews BetMGM Partnership amid concerns over gambling advertising
Article Text:
Connor McDavid (Credit: Getty Images)

Connor McDavid will promote gambling on BetMGM in Ontario under the so-called “responsible gambling” messaging

Edmonton Oilers captain Connor McDavid has reportedly renewed his partnership with BetMGM amid concerns over gambling advertising. This extension of the partnership could draw sharp criticism from gambling-harm advocates over the influence of betting-related messaging on sports fans.The multiyear agreement, announced on October 15, will see the NHL superstar continue to appear in the company's responsible gambling campaigns across broadcast, digital, and social media platforms. According to reports, McDavid will continue to promote gambling on BetMGM in Ontario under the so-called “responsible gambling” messaging, a widely discredited framework for dealing with the public health consequences of commercialized sports gambling.As Edmonton Oilers captain Connor McDavid has extended his partnership with BetMGM, it has come to light that he will continue to promote gambling on BetMGM in Ontario under the so-called “responsible gambling” messaging. It is a widely discredited framework for dealing with the public health consequences of commercialized sports gambling. The World Health Organization is among the groups that have called the framework ineffective.However, the Canadian Medical Experts have criticized the same, stating in one of their study, “Recognizing that youth are particularly vulnerable to the messaging of betting as an augmentation of spectatorship, in 2024 the Alcohol and Gaming Commission of Ontario banned online gambling ads that feature athletes and celebrities.However, within days, commercials with celebrity athletes promoting ‘responsible gaming’ features of sports betting platforms were released to sidestep the ban.The study also added, "Warnings to game responsibly have, however, been shown in a systematic review of 166 studies to be ineffective, which highlights the weak efforts of provincial governments who stand to make substantial revenue from iGaming (Ontario’s open single-game industry produced a total tax revenue of more than $1.4 billion during its first 3 years).”As per reports, McDavid first joined BetMGM's roster of ambassadors in March 2022. Under the renewed agreement, he will continue promoting the company's player-protection tools, including deposit limits, stake limits, time-out features, and self-exclusion options, available through the BetMGM app. The company also plans to expand the campaign to new audiences and markets.Meanwhile, BetMGM CEO Adam Greenblatt praised McDavid's involvement, saying the partnership had helped make responsible gambling messaging engaging and encouraged customers to use player-protection tools.He added, “The results of our campaign reflect how thoughtful messaging can drive meaningful action, with more players using tools like deposit limits to play within their comfort level. We’re proud to continue working with one of hockey’s most respected leaders to ensure that gaming is always fun and entertaining.”McDavid also highlighted the importance of discipline and decision-making, drawing a comparison between hockey and sports betting. “Being disciplined and making smart decisions are big parts of hockey. They're important when it comes to sports betting, too,” McDavid said.The renewed agreement comes as sports betting companies continue to promote player-protection measures while facing broader scrutiny over the effects of gambling advertising on consumers, particularly.
Article Summary: Connor McDavid will continue to promote gambling on BetMGM in Ontario under the so-called “responsible gambling” messaging. The World Health Organization is among the groups that have called the framework ineffective. This extension of the partnership could draw sharp criticism from gambling-harm advocates over the influence of betting-related messaging.

Article Title: CUPRA unveils sporty Raval, new Formula E car at Paris Motor Show
Article Text:
Cupra Kiro new car

CUPRA Raval gets a sporty new look

Raval orders cross 50,000 as CUPRA targets further growth

CUPRA KIRO reveals new Formula E car for 2026/27

CUPRA has showcased several new products and technologies at the Paris Motor Show. The highlights include a new styling package for its Raval electric hatchback, a new Formula E car for the 2026/27 season and an updated audio system developed with Sennheiser. The company also displayed the Tindaya show car, which offers a glimpse of its future design plans. The exhibits are on display in Pavilion 4 from October 12 to 18.CUPRA has introduced the CUSTOM CUPRA by ABT package for its Raval electric hatchback. The package was previously available for the Leon and Formentor models.Inspired by the UrbanRebel concept, the new package adds front and rear splitters, side skirts, a large roof spoiler and winglets. It also includes 19-inch Sport Black Matt alloy wheels, ABT lettering, Dark Chrome CUPRA logos and special interior details.ID@undefined Caption not available.The package focuses on design, and CUPRA has not announced any changes to the car's performance. Customers will be able to select the package for certain Raval variants through the company's online configurator from the end of November 2026.For new cars, the parts will be handcrafted at the CUPRA Racing Factory before being fitted.Existing Raval owners can also get the package installed later through authorised dealers.The Raval is an important model for CUPRA as the company expands its electric vehicle range. The car is produced at the Martorell plant in Spain, where SEAT and CUPRA have invested more than €3 billion in electric vehicle production.The factory also plays a key role in the Volkswagen Group's Electric Urban Car Family, which includes four electric models from CUPRA, Volkswagen and Škoda.CUPRA said it had received more than 50,000 orders for the Raval since April, more than twice its original forecast. Nearly 15,000 cars have been delivered so far.The brand's sales chief, Sven Schuwirth, said CUPRA aims to sell 100,000 Raval units next year. If it reaches that target, the electric hatchback will become the company's best-selling model.CUPRA also reported more than 250,000 deliveries between January and September, an increase of 2% compared with the same period last year.Demand for battery-electric vehicles (BEVs) grew much faster. Orders for these models increased by 79% to more than 108,000. Nearly half of all orders received in the third quarter were for fully electric vehicles.The planned features include an illuminated logo, indicators that project onto the ground and a top speed of up to 190 km/h. The car will also get a reversing assist feature that can retrace up to 50 metres of its previous forward path.CUPRA also presented its new Formula E car for the 2026/27 season. The car, powered by Porsche technology, marks the team's entry into the championship's GEN4 era. The new generation of Formula E cars can reach speeds of more than 335 km/h and accelerate from 0 to 100 km/h in less than two seconds. They also feature permanent all-wheel drive.The car retains the team's signature copper colour scheme.ID@undefined Caption not available.British driver Jake Hughes will join the team for the new season. He brings experience from Formula E, including two podium finishes and four pole positions.Pepe Martí will continue for a second season. He was the highest-placed rookie in the previous season and secured podium finishes in Monaco and Sanya.CUPRA also used the event to showcase new in-car audio technology. The Tavascan Black Edition features the SENNHEISER AMBEO Immersive Sound System. Four actuators positioned along the roofline add a height effect to create a 360-degree audio experience. The updated Formentor and Terramar models will also receive the same system. Meanwhile, the Leon and Leon Sportstourer will offer the IMMERSIVE BY SENNHEISER audio system.Also read: Taylor Barnard joins Fortescue Zero Racing for Formula E's GEN4 era in 2026/27
Article Summary: CUPRA has unveiled a new styling package for its Raval electric hatchback. The company also presented its new Formula E car for the 2026/27 season. CUPRA also used the event to showcase new in-car audio technology.

Article Title: Jaguar unveils Type 01 electric car with 1,030PS power and 450-mile range
Article Text:
Jaguar Type 01

Jaguar Type 01 revealed: 0-62mph in 3.2 seconds, 450-mile range and luxury cabin

A modern cabin with new technology

What does the Type 01 name mean?

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

When will the Jaguar Type 01 go on sale?

Jaguar on Friday unveiled the Type 01, an all-electric luxury car that marks a new beginning for the British carmaker. Revealed in New York City, the four-door grand tourer combines high performance with modern design and new technology. One of the car's biggest highlights is its acceleration. It can go from 0 to 62 mph in just 3.2 seconds. It has three electric motors that produce 1,030PS of power and 1,365Nm of torque.The Type 01 is Jaguar's new flagship electric car. It comes with a 118kWh usable battery pack and offers a claimed range of up to 400 miles under US EPA testing. Its range is up to 450 miles (720km) under WLTP testing.The car uses an 850-volt electrical system that supports fast charging. When connected to a 350kW DC fast charger, it can add 200 miles of range in just 13 minutes.ID@undefined Caption not available.Built on Jaguar's new Electric Architecture (JEA), the Type 01 has been designed to offer a balance of performance and comfort. Its design includes a low roof, a long bonnet, a short front overhang and large 23-inch wheels. The car also has a 50:50 weight distribution, which is aimed at improving handling.Jaguar has also added intelligent torque vectoring and active aerodynamics to improve performance. These features include movable air vents and a rear spoiler that can extend in three stages. The car has a drag coefficient of 0.23, helping it move through the air more efficiently.The Type 01 has a cabin designed around luxury and technology. A central section divides the interior into four separate areas.The cabin features brass-effect aluminium trim, a 24-inch OLED driver display made from a single piece of glass and a separate 7-inch touchscreen. It also gets a full-width panoramic soundbar and seats with audio features designed to improve the listening experience.Jaguar says the name Type 01 reflects both its history and its future. The word "Type" pays tribute to famous models from the brand's past. The number "0" represents zero emissions, while "1" marks the first car of its new generation.The car also benefits from technology developed through Jaguar TCS Racing's Formula E programme, which has won two world championships.The Type 01 can accelerate from 62 mph to 112 mph (100km/h to 180km/h) in just 4.0 seconds.Designed, engineered and manufactured in the UK, the Type 01 is an important part of Jaguar's move towards becoming a fully electric luxury car brand. Prices start at £130,000, with the US price listed at $130,500. Higher-specification versions and customised models are expected to cost more than £150,000.Jaguar plans to open order books in early 2027, with the first customer deliveries expected in the second half of the year.Also read: Sebastien Buemi ends full-time Formula E career, stays with Envision as advisor
Article Summary: The Type 01 is Jaguar's new flagship electric car. It has three electric motors that produce 1,030PS of power and 1,365Nm of torque. It can go from 0 to 62 mph in just 3.2 seconds. Prices start at £130,000, with the US price listed at $130,500.

Article Title: Formula E names COMSOL its Official Multiphysics Partner in new multi-year deal
Article Text:
Formula E and Comsol

Formula E joins hands with COMSOL to boost electric racing technology

AI and digital twins also in focus

Join conversation View All Comments → Share your thoughts in the comments Post Comment Be respectful · TOI community guidelines

GEN4 to bring bigger technology demands

Formula E on Thursday announced a new multi-year partnership with COMSOL, which will become the Official Multiphysics Partner of the ABB FIA Formula E World Championship. The partnership brings together Formula E, the world's leading all-electric motorsport championship, and COMSOL, a company known for its multiphysics simulation and computer-aided engineering software. As part of the partnership, Formula E and COMSOL engineers will use COMSOL Multiphysics to study complex engineering problems involving several physical systems working together.Electric race cars depend on several systems at the same time. These include electrical, thermal, structural, electromagnetic, fluid and battery systems.All these systems have to work together under tough performance and energy limits. COMSOL will provide Formula E's technology teams with simulation software and technical expertise to help them understand how these different physical effects interact.ID@undefined Caption not available.The partnership will also look at simulation apps and digital twin technology. The aim is to make engineering information easier to use outside the traditional modelling process.Bjorn Sjodin, SVP of Product Management at COMSOL, said, “Formula E is a great example of why multiphysics simulation matters, as multiple phenomena are at play and constantly interact with one another.We are excited to work directly with Formula E's technology team and put COMSOL Multiphysics to work on these kinds of real-world challenges.”Formula E CTO Dan Cherowbrier said the partnership will strengthen the championship's engineering capabilities.“Technology is at the heart of Formula E, so partnering with COMSOL makes real sense for us and truly enhances our engineering skillsets. COMSOL gives us a powerful environment for understanding complex systems where many different physical effects are connected, but the opportunity goes beyond individual simulations. We're particularly interested in how AI-assisted modelling, agentic workflows, and digital twins can help engineers interact with models, explore designs, and make simulation insight more accessible as we continue to push the limits of electric racing,” he said.The partnership comes as Formula E prepares for the next generation of its cars.The GEN4 era will bring greater demands in areas such as speed, efficiency, energy management and vehicle development. It will introduce what Formula E describes as its fastest and most technologically advanced race car so far.COMSOL has also announced COMSOL Multiphysics version 2027, which is scheduled to arrive later this autumn.The new version will include features aimed at advanced engineering work, including dedicated electric motor modelling, system-level simulation, agentic modelling and wider access to tools for creating simulation apps.The partnership was announced at the COMSOL Conference 2026 Boston. Formula E CTO Dan Cherowbrier also delivered a keynote speech at the event, discussing the technology and engineering that could shape the future of Formula E.
Article Summary: Formula E joins hands with COMSOL to boost electric racing technology. Aim is to make engineering information easier to use outside the traditional modelling process. AI and digital twins also in focus as Formula E prepares for the next generation of its cars.
